name: @elizaos/os
description: elizaOS operating-system distributions, installers, and release infrastructure.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd setup build && bun run --cwd usb-installer build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p linux/installer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p setup/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p setup/tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p usb-installer/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd linux/installer lint:check && bun run --cwd setup lint:check && bun run --cwd usb-installer lint:check
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write linux/installer && bun run --cwd setup format && bun run --cwd usb-installer format
scripts.test: bun run --cwd linux/installer test && bun run --cwd setup test && bun run --cwd usb-installer test
scripts.verify: bun run verify:layout && bun run verify:installer-native && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:release
scripts.verify:linux: bash scripts/linux/mkosi-lint.sh && python3 scripts/linux/test_disposable_disk_vm.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_mkosi_qualification.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_verify_desktop_artifact.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_stage_browser_artifact.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_assemble_browser_payload.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_mkosi_reproducibility.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_riscv64_agent_staging.py
